system.description:
As an additional downtime move, roll a
d6 to see what you scavenge.
Work with the GM to describe it and
add it to your inventory as a
consumable. Your party can carry up to
five scavenged consumables at a time.
1- A unique ration, stimulant, or
comfort item (Clear 2 Stress)
2- A beautiful relic, valuable trinket, or
black-market find (Gain 2 Hope)
3- An old access chip, route marker, or
field module (+2 to an Interface Roll)
4- A medical vial, trauma patch, or
emergency stabilizer (Clear 2 HP)
5- A luck charm, loaded die, or old-
world token (Reroll any die)
6- Choose one of the options above.
